items.raw_excerpt: Four individuals were detained in Bareilly for selling non-veg food along Kanwariya routes, violating local regulations during the pilgrimage.
items.summary_en: Four people were detained in Bareilly for selling non-veg food along Kanwariya pilgrimage routes. The sales broke local rules during the pilgrimage. Their shop was also razed by officials.
items.summary_ko: 인도 우타르프라데시주 바레일리에서 순례 행진 기간에 육류를 판매한 4명이 붙잡혔다. 현지 규정을 어겼다는 이유였다. 상점도 철거됐다.
items.title_en: Four detained for selling non-veg food on Kanwariya route in Bareilly
items.title_ko: 인도 바레일리, 순례 행진길에서 육류 판매한 4명 붙잡혀
items.title_original: Four detained for selling non-veg food on routes for Kanwariyas, shop razed in Bareilly

items.raw_excerpt: Fast-track approval has been granted for the development of more than 1200 homes in North Auckland, where treated wastewater will be trucked off-site when needed.
items.summary_en: A plan to build more than 1,200 homes in North Auckland has been given fast-track approval. Treated wastewater will be trucked away from the site when needed.
items.summary_ko: 오클랜드 북부에서 1,200채가 넘는 주택을 짓는 계획이 신속 승인을 받았습니다. 필요할 때는 처리한 오수를 현장 밖으로 트럭으로 실어 나를 예정입니다.
items.title_en: Fast-track approval for 1,200 new homes in North Auckland
items.title_ko: 오클랜드 북부 새 주택 1,200채 건설, 신속 승인 받아
items.title_original: Delmore housing development with plan to truck wastewater away gets fast-track approval

items.raw_excerpt: ครั้งหนึ่งเคยถูกวางแผนให้เป็นที่พักพิงสำหรับผู้ประสบภัยจากสารเอเจนต์ออเรนจ์หลายพันคน แต่หลังจากผ่านไปเกือบสิบปี หมู่บ้านออเรนจ์ (นครโฮจิมินห์) ก็ยังคงเป็นเพียงความฝันที่ยังไม่เป็นจริง
items.summary_en: Orange Village in Ho Chi Minh City was planned as a shelter for thousands of Agent Orange victims. After nearly ten years, the village is still not built. It remains only an unrealized dream, officials say.
items.summary_ko: 호찌민시에 있는 오렌지 마을은 수천 명의 에이전트 오렌지 피해자를 위한 보호시설로 계획됐습니다. 하지만 거의 10년이 지난 지금도 마을은 지어지지 못했습니다. 관계자는 이곳이 아직 실현되지 못한 꿈으로 남아 있다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: Orange Village project remains a dream for Agent Orange victims
items.title_ko: 에이전트 오렌지 피해자를 위한 오렌지 마을, 10년째 꿈에 그치다
items.title_original: พลตรี เหงียน ฮง ซอน: โครงการหมู่บ้านออเรนจ์เป็นความฝันและความห่วงใยของผู้ที่ได้รับผลกระทบจากสารเอเจนต์ออเรนจ์ - Vietnam.vn
